name: Nürburgring
notes: Nurburgring Grand Prix circuit with the Mercedes Arena (clockwise), the F1 layout of 2011 and 2013. Via route over the raceways as in dtm-1991 nuerburgring, with the 'Variante 24h-Rennen' (way 31010602) and the motorcycle NGK chicane (way 820679450) excluded, so the lap takes the Mercedes Arena and the F1 chicane. Traced 5063 m vs 5148 m. Start line as in dtm-era4 nuerburgring13. 60 laps (2011). One DRS zone on the pit straight; the 2011 and 2013 zone position is not verified. Values from 2012 F1: race laps, pit lane loss and overtaking are approximate. tyre_wear_mult and the wet weather multiplier are first guesses and will be tuned. speed_scale is 1.0 until the lap time calibration against the 2012 pole. pole_side is the inside of the first corner (approximate).
